description: The 'jobs_and_scenarios_by_project_key' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various projects, focusing on job execution scenarios. It includes key metrics such as start times, durations, errors, and warnings, which are crucial for analyzing project performance and identifying potential issues. The dataset is particularly useful for project managers and data analysts who need to monitor and optimize project workflows. By examining the start and end times, users can assess the efficiency of job executions. The dataset also includes error and warning metrics, which help in identifying and troubleshooting problems. Additionally, the dataset tracks the number of distinct users involved in each project, providing insights into team collaboration. Overall, this dataset is a valuable resource for improving project management and ensuring successful project outcomes.
shortDesc: Dataset of project job scenarios with time and error metrics.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Identifier for the project; key for project events.

columns.name: start_time_min
columns.comment: Earliest start time of a job, indicates job initiation.

columns.name: start_time_max
columns.comment: Latest start time of a job, indicates job initiation.

columns.name: duration_seconds_max
columns.comment: Maximum duration of a job in seconds, measures job length.

columns.name: duration_seconds_median
columns.comment: Median duration of a job in seconds, measures job length.

columns.name: duration_seconds_sum
columns.comment: Total duration of all jobs in seconds, measures job length.

columns.name: age_days_min
columns.comment: Minimum age of a job in days, indicates job recency.

columns.name: error_avg
columns.comment: Average number of errors per job, measures job reliability.

columns.name: error_sum
columns.comment: Total number of errors in jobs, measures job reliability.

columns.name: warnings_count_avg
columns.comment: Average number of warnings per job, measures job reliability.

columns.name: warnings_count_sum
columns.comment: Total number of warnings in jobs, measures job reliability.

columns.name: user_distinct
columns.comment: Number of distinct users involved, indicates team size.

columns.name: count
columns.comment: Total number of jobs, measures project activity.
